Health Sciences at the University of Southampton is training the next generation of professionals in nursing, midwifery, healthcare science, physiotherapy, podiatry and occupational therapy.

Our nursing is ranked 10th in the world and 3rd amongst UK universities (QS World Rankings 2017).
